member.name: M:Roblox.Platform.AssetPermissions.AssetPermissionsVerifier.IsCopyLocked(Roblox.Platform.Assets.IPlace)
member.summary: Checks if a place is able to be copied.
member.remarks: This is different check from the extension method. The extension method checks if the place is able to be copied as a template to be created by a universe. This method checks the AssetOption to see if it can be copied as a place to be created by a user.
member.returns: true if the place can be copied by a user.

member.name: M:Roblox.Platform.AssetPermissions.IAssetPermissionsVerifier.CanEdit(Roblox.Platform.Membership.IUser,Roblox.Platform.Assets.IPlace)
member.summary: Verifies if an has permission to edit a place.
member.remarks:
Do not use this check to check whether or not a user can publish a place. This is specifically whether or not the user is allowed to open it in studio.
Currently this only checks if the user CanManage, or if the place is not copylocked. Ideally this would also check if the user has access to TeamCreate the place. To do that we need to delete Roblox.Platform.CloudEdit dependency on Roblox.Platform.TeamCreate (WEBAPI-2627)
member.returns: true if the user can edit the .
member.exception: Thrown if groups service is down
